title: Make a cold reviewer child's window resident before a recovered review submission reopens its Failed delegation
outcome: record_delegation_review_submission, reached from recover_durable_delegation_review_submission (src/delegation_review_results.rs:532), reopens a Failed reviewer delegation and calls refresh_delegation_from_child_locked, which reads the child's resident messages for its outcome and observed workspace changes. With a cold finished child (from the cold-transcript change), those messages are empty. The outcome then reads as idle without a result, the delegation records the transport note "Child became idle without a final assistant packet after structured result submission", and transcript-derived observed changes are lost. The result itself still comes from the submitted envelope. Fix direction: call hydrate_cold_session_window and hold its pin across the record step, as the follow-up and review-attempt paths already do. Provenance: Low from the Claude reviewer of round-4 pair B3C1-PAIR4-B7083A1E (resultId review-result-bd6ac0260f911b9f0e2480f6787a6b22e7ddb34af9f749427c89c643273eb4ed, attempt 1) on w-b3c1cd1bcea1 candidate b7083a1e. The reviewer called it narrow and did not establish that it happens in practice.
acceptance: Make a cold reviewer child's window resident before a recovered review submission reopens its Failed delegation is done
